target_customer: Team managers and HR or people ops at companies, especially remote and distributed teams, who book retreats and offsites
problem: Planning a team offsite takes months of venue search, vendor vetting and quotes. TeamOut offers bookable venues and planning help in days.
business_model: Marketplace and service revenue on booked retreats (venue commission and planning fees; exact take rate not found)

founders.name: Thomas Mazimann
prior_employers: Voxeet (first employee, acquired by Dolby Laboratories)
founders.background_notes: YC launch post calls him a former professional kayaker who has designed adventure experiences.

founders.name: Vincent Albouy
founders.background_notes: YC page says he is a software engineer and machine learning scientist with patents and seven AI papers; launch post calls him a former professional ski athlete.

competitors.name: Offsyte
competitors.what: Organizes offsite events and retreats for remote teams
competitors.funding_then: Seed of $1.5M dated March 2021 per CB Insights (aggregator, search snippet)

competitors.name: Remi
competitors.what: Berlin culture building platform for remote teams (adjacent, not a venue marketplace)

technical_complexity.rationale: A venue directory, quoting and booking workflow is conventional web work; the hard part is supply sourcing and operations, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Venues are available to everyone, several startups targeted remote retreats in 2021, and TeamOut's own 2026 post says large event business had low repeat business and thin margins.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found; no sourced evidence of a larger player copying or buying TeamOut through 2026.

market_need_then: Return to in person gatherings after COVID and the rise of remote teams created demand; the YC page cites customers such as Netflix, Brex, Kayak and Cloudflare and the YC launch post says planning offsites is a headache that can be a full time job.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and simple, motto 'Corporate Retreats Made Simple'

branding.brand_signature: The motto 'Corporate Retreats Made Simple' and videos of its own team retreats
branding.community_and_virality: Case studies and retreat videos on its site; no press on the brand itself found.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear, descriptive name on a .com, but generic and no brand specific press, merch or community was found.

pivots.from: Large retreats of 20 or more people booked mostly through hotels
pivots.to: Small group offsites in 100 plus lower cost homes and villas
pivots.why: Company blog says large events had low repeat business, thin margins and unpredictable revenue, and rising hotel prices hurt clients.

outcome_analysis: TeamOut is active with named customers such as Netflix, but funding and revenue are not public. Its own November 2026 post admits the large event model had low repeat business and thin margins, so it is adding small group offsites. Whether this is a stall or a healthy adjustment cannot be judged from public sources, so no factors are assigned.
notes: Company site teamout.com was rate limited by the fetch safety check and was not opened; company facts come from the YC pages, YC launch post, company blog and search results. Funding exists only in aggregators (CB Insights $560K over 5 rounds, VCBacked lists YC, Pioneer Fund, FundersClub, Karman Ventures, Louva Invest) so no round is recorded and these are unverified. Competitor entries come from search snippets, not opened pages; Offsite (retreat planner, $3M reported in 2023) is later than the batch and left out. YC launch post is dated only as over 3 years old.
